name: SVG Uploader
author: parasdev

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to upload SVG images into the WordPress media library, which is not allowed by default.

The plugin includes a basic sanitization method to ensure that only safe elements are retained from uploaded SVGs.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin safe to use?

Yes, the plugin sanitizes SVG files before saving them to the media library to ensure security.
